description: Foundation + critical path (1B). Add the mock feature-flag module, then connect the existing promotion engine (src/engine, calculate()) to the live cart/payment so Happy Hour / Buy X Get Y / Mix&Match / member price / stacking all auto-apply at sale time — not just coupons. This is the single biggest gap. Also persist completed sales to saleHistoryStore (currently missing) so later dashboard/history work has real data. Independent of all other FEATs except that they build on the flags module and the PaymentScreen changes here.
steps: Create src/config/featureFlags.ts exporting a dependency-free object FEATURE_FLAGS with MOCK_PAYMENT_AUTOCONFIRM, MOCK_LINE, MOCK_SYNC, MOCK_ERP, each defaulting to ENV.ENABLE_MOCK (import ENV from src/config/env.ts). Export a type for it. No React, no store imports.

Read src/engine/__tests__/engine.test.ts FIRST for exact benefit/condition param keys, and src/engine/types/inputs.ts|outputs.ts|enums.ts for the shapes. Create src/engine/adapter/cartAdapter.ts: buildCalculationRequest({cartItems, subtotal, member, promotions, businessDateTime, storeCode, couponCode?}) returning a CalculationRequest, and runCartPromotions(args) returning {appliedBenefits, totalDiscount, finalPayable, freeGifts, trace} by calling calculate().

In cartAdapter, map cartStore CartItem -> engine CartItem: lineId=product.id, itemCode=product.code, groupCodes=[product.category], quantity=qty, unitPrice=unitPrice, lineAmount=subtotal. Map each active Promotion (src/types/promotion.ts) -> PromotionConfig(type PROMOTION, status ACTIVE, priority from promo.priority, stackMode from promo.stackable, start/endDate from promo dates): percent -> benefit percent_discount{percent:discountPercent,maxDiscount}; fixed -> benefit bill_discount{amount:discountAmount} + condition purchaseAmount{operator:MORE_THAN,threshold:minPurchase-0.01}; member_price -> percent_discount + member/level condition from applicableLevels; buy_x_get_y -> condition product{itemCodes:applicableProducts,operator:EVERY,threshold:buyQty} + benefit free_gift{productCode:getProductId,productName,quantity:getQty,value}; happy_hour -> time condition{startTime,endTime} + percent_discount; mix_match -> product group condition + amount_discount. Include a coupon promo as an engine candidate ONLY when couponCode is provided and matches.

Add vitest tests at src/engine/adapter/__tests__/cartAdapter.test.ts (real test()/expect blocks so they run under `npm test`): cover percent, fixed-with-min, member_price (level match/no-match), buy_x_get_y gift, happy_hour time window, mix_match, and coupon-only-when-entered. Assert on finalTotals + appliedBenefits from runCartPromotions.
Add a mix_match mock promotion to src/data/mockPromotions.ts (type 'mix_match', active, with applicableProducts/categories + discountAmount) so mock data has 7/7 promo types.

Wire cartAdapter into src/screens/sale/PaymentScreen.tsx: on entering payment, call runCartPromotions with cart items, subtotal (getSubtotal), selectedMember, usePromoStore active promotions, now(), store code, and the entered couponCode. Replace the coupon-only grandTotal math with engine finalTotals (keep service charge + existing point redeem). Render a named applied-promotion list (promotionName + value, Thai). Keep the coupon input working (feed it into the engine run) and keep point earn/redeem behavior.

In PaymentScreen handleConfirmPayment, build a SaleRecord and call useSaleHistoryStore.getState().addSale(...) with items, payments, totals, memberId/name, pointsEarned, cashier/pos names, status 'completed' (this call is currently absent). Keep existing deductStock + shift addCashSale + earnPoints.
Optionally surface the applied-promotion list in src/screens/sale/CartScreen.tsx using the same adapter output.
acceptance_criteria: src/config/featureFlags.ts exists and all four flags default to ENV.ENABLE_MOCK.
src/engine/adapter/cartAdapter.ts exists; `npm test` runs src/engine/adapter/__tests__/cartAdapter.test.ts and all its cases pass.
mockPromotions.ts contains a mix_match promotion (7/7 types present).
PaymentScreen computes totals from engine finalTotals and shows a named applied-promotion list; coupon entry still works; point earn/redeem unchanged.
A completed payment adds a SaleRecord via saleHistoryStore.addSale.
verification: npm run lint (no new tsc errors beyond baseline 13)
npm test (cartAdapter tests pass; no non-baseline regressions)
findings:
ADAPTER (src/engine/adapter/cartAdapter.ts): two exports. buildCalculationRequest(args: BuildCalculationArgs): CalculationRequest. runCartPromotions(args: BuildCalculationArgs): CartPromotionResult. BuildCalculationArgs = { cartItems: SaleCartItem[]; subtotal: number; member?: {id,level}|null; promotions: Promotion[]; businessDateTime: string; storeCode: string; couponCode?: string }. CartPromotionResult = { appliedBenefits: AppliedBenefit[]; totalDiscount: number (item+bill discount); finalPayable: number (subtotal after promos ONLY, NO service charge / point redeem); freeGifts: FreeGift[]; trace: ExplainEntry[] }. Exported type AdapterMember = Pick<Member,'id'|'level'>|null|undefined. Cart mapping: lineId=product.id, itemCode=product.code, groupCodes=[product.category], quantity=qty, unitPrice=unitPrice, lineAmount=subtotal(line net). Promo->config: percent->percent_discount; fixed->bill_discount + purchaseAmount(MORE_THAN,minPurchase-0.01); coupon->percent_discount OR bill_discount (+purchaseAmount if minPurchase); member_price->member{levels}+percent_discount; buy_x_get_y->product{itemCodes,EVERY,buyQty}+free_gift{value:0}; happy_hour->time{startTime,endTime}+product{groupCodes:categories}+percent_discount; mix_match->product{itemCodes/groupCodes,EVERY,buyQty?}+amount_discount{amount}. stackable->StackMode(STACK_ALLOWED|NO_STACK). Date YYYY-MM-DD padded to ISO T00:00:00/T23:59:59. NOTE: amount_discount applies per eligible line, so mix_match discountAmount is per matched line.
COUPON GATING: coupon-type promos are candidates ONLY when couponCode matches promo.couponCode/promoCode (case-insensitive).
PAYMENTSCREEN (src/screens/sale/PaymentScreen.tsx): engineResult = useMemo(runCartPromotions(...)) deps [items, selectedMember, appliedCouponCode, getActivePromotions, getSubtotal]. storeCode hardcoded 'STORE-001'. grandTotal = max(0, engineResult.finalPayable + scAmount - pointDiscount). Applied-promotion list renders INSIDE the styles.summaryBox block (after the manual-discount row) mapping engineResult.appliedBenefits -> promotionName + value (free_gift rows show qty x). Coupon flow: handleValidateCoupon validates via promoStore then sets appliedCouponCode(couponCode) which feeds the engine; couponDiscount is now just a boolean flag for the coupon-applied feedback badge. applyCoupon() in handleConfirmPayment pulls the real discount value from the engine benefit whose promotionName === couponPromoName.
SALEHISTORY WIRING: handleConfirmPayment now calls useSaleHistoryStore.getState().addSale({ id:saleNo, saleNo, items, payments, discount, subtotal:getSubtotal(), discountTotal:getDiscountTotal()+promotionDiscount, serviceCharge:scAmount, vatAmount:getVatAmount(), grandTotal, receivedAmount:totalPaid, changeAmount, memberId, memberName, pointsEarned:floor(grandTotal/pointConfig.earnRate), cashierName:'แคชเชียร์', posName:'POS 1', status:'completed', createdAt:new Date() }). pointsEarned computed locally (member only). Still does deductStock + shift.addCashSale + earnPoints/redeemPoints + auto level-upgrade as before.
FEATURE FLAGS: src/config/featureFlags.ts exports FEATURE_FLAGS (MOCK_PAYMENT_AUTOCONFIRM/MOCK_LINE/MOCK_SYNC/MOCK_ERP all = ENV.ENABLE_MOCK) and interface FeatureFlags. Dependency-free (only imports ENV).
MOCK DATA: added promo-007 MIXSNACK60 (type mix_match, category ขนม, buyQty 3, discountAmount 60) -> mockPromotions now 7/7 types.
VERIFICATION: lint=13 baseline errors (no new); npm test=14 cartAdapter tests pass + only the 3 baseline suite-load failures; engine self-test Failed:0.
